exact_statement: For every finite distinct actual-run collection of one fixed generator with exact masses c_r(lambda)/Z(lambda), Z>0 on its admissible physical parameter domain, every finite Boolean nonempty squared spectrum p of total mass v, and every eligible fixed public-mixture candidate Q0 positive on supp p, a rational polynomial certificate M Z(lambda)-sum_A p(A)N_A(lambda)/Q0(A)>=0 throughout that domain implies C(Q0)-(M-v)/ln(2)<=inf_Q C(Q)<=C(Q0), where N_A sums actual run numerators once, C(Q)=sum_A p(A)log2(1/Q(A)), and the infimum includes all fixed public mixtures of admissible references from this run collection. With M=v the candidate is globally optimal. On the fixed fifteen-run maximal-matching star subreference for the K3 edge-union function, all incidence-feasible positive weights and all fixed mixtures have exact infimum (3/4)log2(217/16)+(1/4)log2(651), attained at lambda=(1/2,1/2,1/2); the earned posterior entropy is3/4+(1/4)log2(6). The physically infeasible used-root-simplex relaxation has gap121/96 natural units at that same candidate, whereas this certificate has zero gap. The claim does not lower-bound references with additional omitted runs and does not provide universal influence payment.
hypotheses: Uniform physical Boolean cube; nonempty target Fourier masses are unnormalized and measured in bits.
One fixed actual generator/run collection, with all duplicates of descriptions merged by identical generator draws; distinct chronological orders remain distinct actual events.
All chosen run masses nonnegative and exact; N and Z rational polynomials after clearing only positive denominators; Z>0 wherever the output law is defined.
Q0 eligible and positive on target support; public mixtures fixed before observing output; certificate checked on entire physical feasible domain.
Calibration uses width-two edge gates on K3, full D=product(1+lambda_i/4)-1, lambda_i>0 and lambda_i+lambda_j<=1; its run collection is a subreference.
proof_dependencies: Elementary logarithmic tangent inequality, finite mixture linearity and explicitly reconstructed width-two queue probabilities; no imported FEI theorem.

exact_statement: For any actual-reference class on a finite output space, nonzero target p supported on d outputs, and an eligible finite mixture Q* positive there satisfying the exact score certificate sum p(A)Q(A)/Q*(A)<=sum p for every allowed component Q, Q* can be compressed to at most d actual components preserving every positive-target output probability and complete posterior-optimized cost; rational data permit rational nullspace elimination. This bound is sharp: for the physical majority3 spectrum on triangle supports, the complete anchor/local-uniform-mask UNION law with all nonnegative activations a,b,c of positive sum and pairwise incidence caps has exact cost infimum over ALL fixed public mixtures equal to 3/2+(3/4)log2(3), attained by branch weight3/8 at (1/2,1/2,1/2) and5/24 at each axis vector. Its full output law gives1/6 per singleton and1/8 per pair and triple; all four branch types are necessary. The single-activation-vector infimum is strictly larger, and the mixed optimum strictly exceeds H=2. This is a generator-specific optimization theorem, not influence payment for arbitrary Boolean functions or a lower bound for other dictionaries.
hypotheses: Finite nonzero target p; Q* eligible finite mixture, positive on supp p; exact score condition on ALL allowed actual components, with fixed public mixing before output.
Compression preserves complete OUTPUT cost with the optimal actual posterior, not an arbitrary frozen witness posterior.
Triangle generator is the stated normalized actual anchor/local-mask UNION law, not A006 fifteen-run forest subreference.
Triangle activations nonnegative, nonzero sum and pairwise caps; strictly positive domain has same infimum via valid boundary limits, not necessarily attainment.
All costs bits, physical cube uniform; no general source-price or FEI theorem asserted.
